description: Local readings and the explicit query keep value tested rule tags from the chart.
grammar:
%rule text r="a" m :: ∅
%rule r A :: T
%rule m M
%check same #·m
%conditions $.preceding-element.local-readings, $.preceding-element.onward.parse(r="a" …),
  $.preceding-element.local-readings.tags = $.preceding-element.onward.parse(r="a" …).tags,
  $.preceding-element.local-readings.tags = T
%warning "same"
